svg.aria-label: Portrait capture with five spot-luminance targets
svg.title: Portrait capture with five spot-luminance targets

g.text: Choose matte, evenly lit patches that the meter spot fills.
Cover darker and brighter surfaces (here 65–415 cd/m²).
Avoid edges, gloss, shadows and clipped pixels.
Keep one target out of the fit as an independent check.
Course notes: Oct 5, 2026, 4:30 pm. Photo EXIF: 4:45:53 pm.
The times differ, so these readings illustrate target
selection; they are not a validated calibration of this frame.
